back_translation: An oracle concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum of Elkosh.
The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD avenges and is full of wrath; the LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.
The LORD is slow to anger and great in power, and the LORD will by no means let the guilty go unpunished. His way is in the whirlwind and the storm, and the clouds are like the dust of His feet.
He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the blossom of Lebanon fades.
The mountains quake before Him and the hills melt away; the earth heaves before Him—the world and all who dwell in it.
Who can endure His indignation? Who can withstand the heat of His anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are shattered before Him.
The LORD is good, a secure refuge in the day of trouble, and He knows those who take refuge in Him.
But with an overflowing flood He will bring Nineveh to an end, and He will pursue His enemies into darkness.
What do you plot against the LORD? He will bring it to a complete end; trouble will not rise up a second time.
For though they are entangled like thorns and drunken with their wine, they will be consumed completely like dry stubble.
O Nineveh, from you came one who plotted evil against the LORD, a wicked and worthless counselor.
This is what the LORD says: Though they are at full strength and many, they will be cut down and pass away. O Judah, though I afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
Now I will break his yoke from your neck and tear your chains apart.

O Nineveh, the LORD has commanded concerning you: 'Your name will no longer be perpetuated. I will cut off the carved image and the cast idol from the temple of your gods. I will dig your grave, for you are vile.'
